requirements.quote:
The certificate type MUST be X.509v3 [RFC5280], unless explicitly
negotiated otherwise (e.g., [RFC7250]).
requirements.condition: the client and server did not explicitly negotiate another certificate type
requirements.why_checkable: Negotiation state and the encoded client certificate type can be compared.

requirements.quote:
If the "certificate_authorities" extension in the
CertificateRequest message was present, at least one of the
certificates in the certificate chain SHOULD be issued by one of
the listed CAs.
requirements.required_behavior: select a chain with at least one certificate issued by a listed CA
requirements.forbidden_behavior: select a chain with no listed-CA relationship without a reason to depart from the recommendation
requirements.why_checkable: Certificate issuers can be compared with the requested authority list.

requirements.quote:
The certificates MUST be signed using an acceptable signature
algorithm, as described in Section 4.3.2.
requirements.condition: the client selects a certificate chain in response to CertificateRequest
requirements.required_behavior: use certificates signed with acceptable signature algorithms
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send a certificate requiring an unacceptable certificate-signature algorithm
requirements.why_checkable: Each certificate signature algorithm can be checked against the request's accepted algorithms.

requirements.quote:
If the CertificateRequest message contained a non-empty
"oid_filters" extension, the end-entity certificate MUST match the
extension OIDs that are recognized by the client, as described in
Section 4.2.5.
requirements.condition: CertificateRequest contains a non-empty oid_filters extension
requirements.required_behavior: select an end-entity certificate matching every filter OID recognized by the client
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send an end-entity certificate that fails a recognized OID filter
requirements.why_checkable: Recognized filters can be evaluated against parsed end-entity certificate extensions.
